users_deleted_at_matches_status_check.name: users_deleted_at_matches_status_check
users_deleted_at_matches_status_check.value: ("users"."status" = 'deleted' AND "users"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("users"."status" <> 'deleted' AND "users"."deleted_at" IS NULL)

applications_status_timestamps_check.name: applications_status_timestamps_check
applications_status_timestamps_check.value:
("applications"."status" = 'submitted' AND "applications"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "applications"."withdrawn_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("applications"."status" IN ('accepted', 'rejected') AND "applications"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "applications"."withdrawn_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("applications"."status" = 'withdrawn' AND "applications"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "applications"."withdrawn_at" IS NOT NULL)

jobs_completed_at_state_check.name: jobs_completed_at_state_check
jobs_completed_at_state_check.value: ("jobs"."status" = 'completed' AND "jobs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("jobs"."status" <> 'completed' AND "jobs"."completed_at" IS NULL)

jobs_cancelled_at_state_check.name: jobs_cancelled_at_state_check
jobs_cancelled_at_state_check.value: ("jobs"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "jobs"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."cancellation_reason" IS NOT NULL) OR ("jobs"."status" <> 'cancelled' AND "jobs"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "jobs"."cancellation_reason" IS NULL)

jobs_hidden_metadata_check.name: jobs_hidden_metadata_check
jobs_hidden_metadata_check.value: ("jobs"."visibility" = 'visible' AND "jobs"."hidden_at" IS NULL AND "jobs"."hidden_by" IS NULL AND "jobs"."hidden_reason" IS NULL) OR ("jobs"."visibility" = 'hidden' AND "jobs"."hidden_at" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."hidden_by" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."hidden_reason" IS NOT NULL)

idempotency_keys_completion_payload_chec.name: idempotency_keys_completion_payload_check
idempotency_keys_completion_payload_chec.value: ("idempotency_keys"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "idempotency_keys"."response_payload" IS NULL) OR ("idempotency_keys"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_keys"."response_payload" IS NOT NULL)

notifications_entity_pair_check.name: notifications_entity_pair_check
notifications_entity_pair_check.value: ("notifications"."entity_type" IS NULL AND "notifications"."entity_id" IS NULL) OR ("notifications"."entity_type" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."entity_id" IS NOT NULL)

reports_has_target_check.name: reports_has_target_check
reports_has_target_check.value: "reports"."job_id" IS NOT NULL OR "reports"."agreement_id" IS NOT NULL OR "reports"."reported_user_id" IS NOT NULL

reports_resolution_metadata_check.name: reports_resolution_metadata_check
reports_resolution_metadata_check.value:
("reports"."status" = 'open' AND "reports"."moderator_id" IS NULL AND "reports"."moderator_note" IS NULL AND "reports"."resolved_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("reports"."status" = 'reviewing' AND "reports"."moderator_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."resolved_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("reports"."status" IN ('resolved', 'rejected') AND "reports"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."moderator_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."moderator_note" IS NOT NULL)

job_boosts_revocation_metadata_check.name: job_boosts_revocation_metadata_check
job_boosts_revocation_metadata_check.value: ("job_boosts"."status" = 'revoked' AND "job_boosts"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("job_boosts"."status" <> 'revoked' AND "job_boosts"."revoked_at" IS NULL)

opportunity_credits_redemption_metadata_.name: opportunity_credits_redemption_metadata_check
opportunity_credits_redemption_metadata_.value:
("opportunity_credits"."status" IN ('earned', 'expired') AND "opportunity_credits"."redeemed_at" IS NULL AND "opportunity_credits"."target_job_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("opportunity_credits"."status" = 'redeemed' AND "opportunity_credits"."redeemed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "opportunity_credits"."target_job_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("opportunity_credits"."status" = 'revoked' AND (("opportunity_credits"."redeemed_at" IS NULL AND "opportunity_credits"."target_job_id" IS NULL) OR ("opportunity_credits"."redeemed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "opportunity_credits"."target_job_id" IS NOT NULL)))

opportunity_credits_revocation_metadata_.name: opportunity_credits_revocation_metadata_check
opportunity_credits_revocation_metadata_.value: ("opportunity_credits"."status" = 'revoked' AND "opportunity_credits"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "opportunity_credits"."revoked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "opportunity_credits"."revocation_reason" IS NOT NULL) OR ("opportunity_credits"."status" <> 'revoked' AND "opportunity_credits"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "opportunity_credits"."revoked_by" IS NULL AND "opportunity_credits"."revocation_reason" IS NULL)

agreements_confirmation_state_check.name: agreements_confirmation_state_check
agreements_confirmation_state_check.value:
("agreements"."status" = 'pending_confirmation' AND ("agreements"."worker_confirmed_at" IS NULL OR "agreements"."employer_confirmed_at" IS NULL))
        OR ("agreements"."status" IN ('active', 'completed') AND "agreements"."worker_confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "agreements"."employer_confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("agreements"."status" = 'cancelled')

agreements_cancellation_metadata_check.name: agreements_cancellation_metadata_check
agreements_cancellation_metadata_check.value: ("agreements"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "agreements"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "agreements"."cancellation_reason" IS NOT NULL) OR ("agreements"."status" <> 'cancelled' AND "agreements"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "agreements"."cancellation_reason" IS NULL)

work_proofs_revocation_metadata_check.name: work_proofs_revocation_metadata_check
work_proofs_revocation_metadata_check.value: ("work_proofs"."verification_status" = 'verified' AND "work_proofs"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "work_proofs"."revoked_by" IS NULL AND "work_proofs"."revocation_reason" IS NULL) OR ("work_proofs"."verification_status" = 'revoked' AND "work_proofs"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "work_proofs"."revoked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "work_proofs"."revocation_reason" IS NOT NULL)

work_sessions_code_metadata_check.name: work_sessions_code_metadata_check
work_sessions_code_metadata_check.value: ("work_sessions"."check_in_code_hash" IS NULL AND "work_sessions"."check_in_code_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("work_sessions"."check_in_code_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "work_sessions"."check_in_code_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

work_sessions_lifecycle_timestamps_check.name: work_sessions_lifecycle_timestamps_check
work_sessions_lifecycle_timestamps_check.value:
("work_sessions"."status" = 'scheduled' AND "work_sessions"."checked_in_at" IS NULL AND "work_sessions"."checked_out_at" IS NULL AND "work_sessions"."verified_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("work_sessions"."status" = 'checked_in' AND "work_sessions"."checked_in_at" IS NOT NULL AND "work_sessions"."checked_out_at" IS NULL AND "work_sessions"."verified_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("work_sessions"."status" = 'checked_out' AND "work_sessions"."checked_in_at" IS NOT NULL AND "work_sessions"."checked_out_at" IS NOT NULL AND "work_sessions"."verified_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("work_sessions"."status" = 'verified' AND "work_sessions"."checked_in_at" IS NOT NULL AND "work_sessions"."checked_out_at" IS NOT NULL AND "work_sessions"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "work_sessions"."verified_by" IS NOT NULL)
